summary: Use Fractal naming in CLI guidance, diagnostics and private test helpers

schema.detail: Wire versions, actor-contract output and generated schemas remain unchanged.

rules.detail: Command behavior and mission rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Legacy executable aliases, JSON compatibility wording, environment contracts, service names, socket names and persisted built-in identities are preserved. The recording publication gate rejects both historical and renamed scenario scratch prefixes.

downtime.detail: No migration or service restart is required for wording changes.

manual.detail: Demo commands, setup and uninstall guidance, and selected CLI diagnostics now use Fractal naming. Private fixture helpers and source comments use the same vocabulary.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no state changes.
